title: Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.20106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning LLMs generate long outputs whose key--value (KV) caches occupy GPU memory for minutes. When memory fills, the server preempts requests, and a preempted request can repeatedly lose and recover its state while producing little new output. We call this behavior KV thrashing. In certain cases, existing systems leave more than a fifth of requests stalled for over a minute. Because preemption cannot be avoided without delaying admission, we ask how to make it productive. We present Stint, a serving system that preserves a preempted request's work, bounds how long it waits, and gives it fresh output after it returns. Stint stores fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with an exact-extent allocator, and moves them with fused K/V gather/scatter kernels and double buffering. Age-based readmission brings stalled requests back, and protection gives them a turn of fresh decoding before another preemption. Remaining-leng

translated_title: 在长输出LLM服务中让抢占变得高效
translated_abstract: 推理型大语言模型会生成很长的输出，其键值（KV）缓存会占用GPU内存长达数分钟。当内存被填满时，服务器会抢占请求，而被抢占的请求可能在几乎不产生新输出的情况下反复丢失和恢复其状态。我们将这种行为称为“KV抖动”（KV thrashing）。在某些情况下，现有系统会让超过五分之一的请求停滞超过一分钟。由于在不延迟请求接纳的情况下无法避免抢占，我们提出了一个问题：如何让抢占变得高效。我们提出了Stint，一个能够保留被抢占请求已有工作、限制其等待时间并在其返回后让其继续产生新输出的服务系统。Stint将固定长度的KV快照存储在以连续性优先、采用精确范围分配器的CPU内存池中，并通过融合的K/V聚合/分散内核和双缓冲机制来移动这些快照。基于年龄的重新接纳机制将停滞的请求重新拉回，保护机制则确保它们在再次被抢占前能获得一轮新解码的机会。
tldr: 本文提出Stint服务系统，通过在CPU内存池中保存被抢占请求的KV快照、结合基于年龄的重新接纳与保护机制，消除了长输出LLM服务中的“KV抖动”问题，使原本造成请求长期停滞的抢占过程变得高效。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Stint, a serving system that makes preemption productive in long-output LLM serving by preserving preempted requests' KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool, combined with age-based readmission and protection mechanisms, eliminating "KV thrashing" that leaves requests stalled.
